The '''Mendacious Oasis''' was an oasis located in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was inhabited by a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] militia led by [[Nekra]] the Warlord.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mendacious Oasis was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
